instruction: Help me disable the 'Allow only one instance' when started from file option in VLC

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling the 'one instance when started from file' setting (one-instance-when-started-from-file). The evaluator uses existing check_one_instance_when_started_from_file metric which reads the VLC config file and checks if one-instance-when-started-from-file=0. Default value is 1 (enabled), so the user must navigate to interface settings and disable it.
